audio_script: After the throw, what forces act on this ball? First choose the system: the ball alone. Once it has left the hand, and if we ignore air resistance, Earth’s gravity is the only external force on it. The green arrow marks its weight, downward. The cyan arrow shows velocity, which is tangent to the path and changes direction as the ball rises and falls. The trail is calculated from the same model: constant horizontal velocity and downward acceleration g. Notice that gravity does not point along the curve, and there is no continuing forward force. The ball is drawn as a complete sphere, with its center marked; this model tracks translation and does not simulate spin. The vectors are schematic, not a scale drawing.
